title: Prove the sharp inverse envelope with forbidden diagonals (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Proves the exact inverse 1-norm envelope for arbitrary finite directed supports under unequal row contraction budgets, including forbidden diagonal entries. This is a **scoped algebraic proof with exact finite corroboration**, not a new kappa or a complete multiplication theorem.

```text
all diagonals allowed: column j = sum_i w_ij / (1-r_j)
arbitrary support:     column j = sum_i w_ij / (1-q_j)
q_j = maximum budget product around a simple directed cycle through j
w_ij = maximum budget product along a simple path from i to j
```

The proof constructs one nonnegative matrix attaining every entry of each chosen column. It extends Ali Romman's merged #5306 and #5255 by removing their all-diagonals-allowed hypothesis; their verifiers are not replayed. A loopless two-vertex example has exact envelope 14/5, compared with 6 in the larger diagonal-completed class. Missing self-loops strictly improve their own column envelope.

[Proof and complete scope](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f585fc78fb2b38bd213d0dd78ec2ade8e10e2fc1/research/support-cycle-resolvent/README.md), [standalone verifier](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f585fc78fb2b38bd213d0dd78ec2ade8e10e2fc1/research/support-cycle-resolvent/verify.py), and [source provenance](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f585fc78fb2b38bd213d0dd78ec2ade8e10e2fc1/research/support-cycle-resolvent/SOURCES.json).

## Evidence

- Complete small-domain comparison covers 3,634 directed-support/budget cases with at least one forbidden diagonal, 50,334 zero-or-saturated policy matrix evaluations, 10,850 full-column attaining inverses, and 10,902 diffuse signed/nonnegative matrix evaluations. These are evaluation counts, not deduplicated matrix counts.
- Separate rational Gauss-Jordan inversion corroborates the maximum-product formula. Explicit acyclic, longer-weighted-cycle and disconnected-cycle examples distinguish the changed hypotheses. Ten rejection controls pass.
- CPython 3.12.15, standard library only: warning-strict normal and optimized direct checks, both registered commands, metadata validation, committed-byte/source-history preflight, and optimized Git-free replay of committed package bytes pass. Each registered command takes about 2.5 seconds locally, below its 180-second bound. The registered pair takes about 5.4 seconds.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/support-cycle-resolvent/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/support-cycle-resolvent/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/support-cycle-resolvent
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/support-cycle-resolvent --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 path can replace the displayed interpreter. Expected markers are `PASS_SUPPORT_CYCLE_RESOLVENT`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Direct replay generates a JSON receipt bound to all five package-file hashes and writes no files by default.

## Limitations

The universal claim rests on the written proof. Finite tests are corroboration, not proof-kernel acceptance. Budgets satisfy 0<r_i<1; allowed entries may be zero. No infinite-graph, mandatory-nonzero-edge, Gaussian-specific or operator 2-norm optimum is claimed. No actual caller's support or budgets are established. Physical preparation, native operations, compiler, ownership, precision/tape, stock and analytic recovery remain separate. Selected cold replay, predecessor scientific suites, native replay, Lean and Docker are unrun. The selected frontier is unchanged.

## Open next questions

- Extract a proven missing-diagonal support and unequal rational row budgets from one emitted rounded coefficient matrix; compute the return-cycle bound and charge preparation. Source binding and physical costs are missing.
- Fix source-compatible per-entry constraints that forbid concentration and determine their sharp envelope. The attaining policies here may be excluded by those additional constraints.

## Related open work

No open PR studying this directed-support/unequal-row inverse envelope was found in the bounded live and cached overlap checks. Merged #5306 and #5255 are the direct predecessors.

## CI notes

CI pending. Local checks above passed; no hosted certification is claimed yet.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. **Blast Radius:** isolated research package. Only five new files under `research/support-cycle-resolvent/` are added.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Ali Romman for #5255/#5306, Cinna Davis #4100 for the conditioning context, James Reed #4282 for periodic sections, and William Lawyer #852 for the different weighted-cycle setting. Classical Neumann, discounted-path and maximum-principle methods retain their credit; general literature priority is unclaimed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.
